name: campusly
description: Campusly: appointments and campus reports for schools, colleges and universities (React + Node.js/Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
scripts.install-all: npm install --ignore-scripts && npm install --prefix server --ignore-scripts && npm install --prefix client --ignore-scripts
